quote: The only thing that is constant is change.
author: Heraclitus

quote: The beginning of wisdom is the definition of terms.
author: Socrates

quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
author: Will Durant

quote: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton

quote: I do not fear computers. I fear the lack of them.
author: Isaac Asimov

quote: The machine does not isolate man from the great problems of nature but plunges him more deeply into them.
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

quote: The art of progress is to preserve order amid change and to preserve change amid order.
author: Alfred North Whitehead

quote: The process of creative destruction is the essential fact about capitalism.
author: Joseph Schumpeter

quote: There is nothing more difficult to take in hand, more perilous to conduct, or more uncertain in its success, than to take the lead in the introduction of a new order of things.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli

quote: I think there is a world market for maybe five computers.
author: Thomas Watson

quote: Television won't be able to hold on to any market it captures after the first six months. People will soon get tired of staring at a plywood box every night.
author: Darryl Zanuck

quote: Where a calculator on the ENIAC is equipped with 18,000 vacuum tubes and weighs 30 tons, computers of the future may have only 1,000 vacuum tubes and perhaps weigh only one and a half tons.
author: Popular Mechanics

quote: Man is a tool-using animal. Without tools he is nothing, with tools he is all.
author: Thomas Carlyle

quote: The factory of the future will have only two employees, a man and a dog. The man will be there to feed the dog. The dog will be there to keep the man from touching the equipment.
author: Warren Bennis

quote: It has become appallingly obvious that our technology has exceeded our humanity.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: The real problem is not whether machines think but whether men do.
author: B.F. Skinner

quote: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
author: Arthur C. Clarke
source: Profiles of the Future (Clarke's Third Law)

quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay

quote: The most dangerous phrase in the language is, 'We've always done it this way.'
author: Grace Hopper
role: Computer scientist & U.S. Navy Rear Admiral

quote: People don't resist change. They resist being changed.
author: Peter Senge

quote: Technology is anything that wasn't around when you were born.
author: Alan Kay

quote: Innovations that are perceived by individuals as having greater relative advantage, compatibility, trialability, observability, and less complexity will be adopted more rapidly than other innovations.
author: Everett Rogers

quote: The diffusion of innovations is a social process, even more than a technical matter.
author: Everett Rogers

quote: Most individuals do not evaluate an innovation on the basis of scientific studies of its consequences. Instead, most people depend mainly upon a subjective evaluation of an innovation that is conveyed to them from other individuals like themselves who have previously adopted the innovation.
author: Everett Rogers

quote: The Internet is becoming the town square for the global village of tomorrow.
author: Bill Gates

quote: We always overestimate the change that will occur in the next two years and underestimate the change that will occur in the next ten.
author: Bill Gates

quote: The advance of technology is based on making it fit in so that you don't really even notice it, so it's part of everyday life.
author: Bill Gates

quote: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
author: Steve Jobs
source: The Innovation Secrets of Steve Jobs

quote: People don't know what they want until you show it to them.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: It's not a faith in technology. It's faith in people.
author: Steve Jobs

quote: The future is already here — it's just not evenly distributed.
author: William Gibson

quote: The first rule of any technology used in a business is that automation applied to an efficient operation will magnify the efficiency. The second is that automation applied to an inefficient operation will magnify the inefficiency.
author: Bill Gates

quote: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
author: John F. Kennedy

quote: Crossing the chasm requires targeting a very specific niche market where you can dominate from the outset.
author: Geoffrey Moore

quote: The only way to discover the limits of the possible is to go beyond them into the impossible.
author: Arthur C. Clarke
source: Profiles of the Future (Clarke's Second Law)

quote: Once a new technology rolls over you, if you're not part of the steamroller, you are part of the road.
author: Stewart Brand

quote: The measure of intelligence is the ability to change.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: The electric light did not come from the continuous improvement of candles.
author: Oren Harari
role: Management professor, University of San Francisco

quote: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master.
author: Christian Lous Lange
role: Norwegian historian & Nobel Peace Prize laureate

quote: The great growling engine of change — technology.
author: Alvin Toffler

quote: The illiterate of the 21st century will not be those who cannot read and write, but those who cannot learn, unlearn, and relearn.
author: Alvin Toffler

quote: The Web as I envisaged it, we have not seen it yet. The future is still so much bigger than the past.
author: Tim Berners-Lee
role: Inventor of the World Wide Web

quote: Move fast and break things. Unless you are breaking stuff, you are not moving fast enough.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

quote: Software is eating the world.
author: Marc Andreessen

quote: Every company is a technology company, no matter what business they think they're in.
author: Satya Nadella

quote: The biggest risk is not taking any risk. In a world that's changing really quickly, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

quote: Culture eats strategy for breakfast.
author: Peter Drucker

quote: What new technology does is create new opportunities to do a job that customers want done.
author: Clayton Christensen

quote: Disruptive technology should be framed as a marketing challenge, not a technological one.
author: Clayton Christensen

quote: AI is probably the most important thing humanity has ever worked on. I think of it as something more profound than electricity or fire.
author: Sundar Pichai

quote: Artificial intelligence would be the ultimate version of Google. The ultimate search engine that would understand everything on the web.
author: Larry Page

quote: Machine intelligence is the last invention that humanity will ever need to make.
author: Nick Bostrom

quote: AI will be the best or worst thing ever for humanity.
author: Elon Musk

quote: Rolling out broad-based AI to an entire employee base is like putting a Peloton in everyone's sitting room. It doesn't mean everyone's going to start to get fit.
author: Industry saying

quote: The development of AI is as fundamental as the creation of the microprocessor, the personal computer, the Internet, and the mobile phone.
author: Bill Gates
source: GatesNotes blog post, 'The Age of AI has begun'

quote: Technology adoption is not about the technology, it's about the people.
author: Venkatesh Rao
source: Tempo: Timing, Tactics and Strategy in Narrative-Driven Decision-Making

quote: Looking at what's possible, it does feel sort of surprisingly slow. There is more resistance to the diffusion, the absorption of AI into the culture and economy than I expected.
author: Sam Altman
